faq_heading: Homes near McCloskey Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the McCloskey Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the McCloskey Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names McCloskey Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near McCloskey Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 88 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,250,000, condos $505,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near McCloskey Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of McCloskey Elementary the median was 27 days on the market, closing at 96.3% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 88 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to McCloskey Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Delta Continuing Education (0.4 km north), North Delta Secondary (0.4 km north) and Richardson Elementary (0.7 km north-west).

McCloskey Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 11531 80 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions McCloskey Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the McCloskey Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names McCloskey Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of McCloskey Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 88 homes sold within 1 km of McCloskey Elementary: 55 houses, 2 townhomes and 16 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,250,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of McCloskey Elementary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of McCloskey Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Delta Continuing Education, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Sunshine Hills Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Richardson Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Richardson Elementary (0.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Richardson Elementary (0.7 km north-west), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (1.0 km south-east), Chalmers Elementary (1.1 km south-west), Hellings Elementary (1.3 km north), Gray Elementary (1.4 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Richardson Elementary, 0.7 km north-west of McCloskey Elementary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of McCloskey Elementary was $1,250,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
